subject: Lifeflow onboarding & deployment plan — handoff
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@lifeflowhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@lifeflowhealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Lifeflow onboarding & deployment plan — handoff

Hi team,

Thanks for the great demo last week — Lifeflow verbally committed on Friday and legal has signaled green for the redlines we discussed. Quick summary for CS and implementation:

- Deal: DL-2026-0585 (Lifeflow Health) — target go-live: 2026-03-01
- Platform mode: Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs) with burst to hosted for peak reports
- Expected steady-state throughput: ~120k tokens/day; peak hourly ~25k tokens
- Models: rwi/gpt-13b (quantized) primary; rwi/gpt-7b fallback for cost-sensitive routes
- Data controls: no PII storage beyond 30 days, customer-managed S3 for logs; KMS for keying
- Security: customer needs SOC 2 attestation copy and network subnet details for VPC peering

Key asks for CS/Implementation:
1) Kickoff week of Jan 19 — Lifeflow requested Wed Jan 21 or Thu Jan 22 for a 60-minute kickoff
2) SSO: Lifeflow uses Okta; they need SAML test account and metadata exchange during sprint0
3) Training: two 60-min ops trainings + one developer deep dive during sprint 1
4) Acceptance criteria: throughput smoke test, latency under 150ms p50 for standard prompt, ingestion pipeline validated

Recommended owners:
- Primary CS lead: Tessa Morgan (onboarding and customer success)
- Technical implementation lead (RTO): Markus Klein (runtime & infra)
- Contract owner/sales contact: Ben Carter

I've attached the signed SOW (Lifeflow_SOW_v3.pdf) and a draft implementation roadmap (Implementation_Roadmap.xlsx). Please confirm owners and the kickoff slot that works for the Lifeflow team.

Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Lifeflow_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf), Implementation_Roadmap.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lifeflow onboarding & deployment plan — handoff

Thanks Ben — appreciated.

Tessa, I'll take runtime/infra coordination for sprint0 and hand over to you for ongoing adoption after the first 30 days. Quick clarifying items for procurement/ops:
- Can Lifeflow provide their Okta metadata and SAML test user by kickoff?
- For VPC peering we'll need the target subnets and an AWS account ID (they mentioned a shared account).
- Which team will own ingestion pipeline validation? (Data engineering at Lifeflow or our integration engineers?)

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Tessa to schedule kickoff (Jan 21 or 22) and send calendar invites with Zoom link
- I will schedule a 30-min pre-kickoff with our infra engineers to scope VPC and peering templates

Ben — tagging you to confirm the procurement contact and whether any additional legal artifacts are outstanding.

Hi Ben / Markus / Tessa,

Thanks for the clear summary. Confirmed — Jan 21 works best for us at 10:00am PT. I've looped in procurement for final billing instructions (procurement@lifeflowhealth.com). A few items from our side:

- We'll share Okta metadata and a SAML test user by EOD Thu Jan 15.
- Procurement would like a SOC 2 copy and a short list of data flow diagrams for our security team prior to kickoff.
- For VPC peering: our infra lead will need the peering template and the list of IP ranges you'll require. Can your team send that before the pre-kick call?

Also, one ask: can you include a short list of roles/responsibilities in the kickoff agenda so we know who to invite internally? (engineering, security, product manager)

Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Samantha Liu
Head of Product Integrations | Lifeflow Health
samantha.liu@lifeflowhealth.com | +1 650-555-0910

Thanks Samantha — Jan 21 at 10:00am PT is set. Invite sent (Zoom link + shared doc). I've attached a short kickoff agenda and roles/responsibilities doc that maps the items Ben listed. Highlights:

- Owners:
  - CS Lead: Tessa Morgan (onboarding, adoption)
  - PM Sponsor (Lifeflow): Samantha Liu
  - Tech Lead (Redwood infra): Markus Klein (sprint0/VPC)
  - Integration Engineer (Redwood): Monica Patel (API contracts & ingestion)
  - Lifeflow Data Eng: TBD (to be provided by Samantha)

- Sprint0 checklist (pre-kickoff action items):

  - Redwood: VPC peering template, SOC 2 copy, initial runbook draft (shared Jan 14)

- Kickoff: Jan 21, 2026 @ 10:00am PT (Zoom invite sent by Tessa)
- Redwood owners: Markus (infra lead, sprint0), Tessa (CS lead), Monica Patel (integration)

I'll run the infra pre-kick call on Jan 19 at 11:00am PT with our engineers — invite to follow. Monica, please join if you can.
